mn12:34.3: taṃ sāriputta vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
mn12:34.4: seyyathāpi sāriputta bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno diṭṭheva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, evaṃ sampadamidaṃ sāriputta vadāmi:

mn12:36.1: nirayañcāhaṃ sāriputta pajānāmi, nirayagāmiñca maggaṃ, nirayagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ.
mn12:36.2: yathā paṭipanno ca kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi.
mn12:36.3: tiracchānayoniñcāhaṃ sāriputta pajānāmi, tiracchānayonigāmiñca maggaṃ, tiracchānayonigāminiñca paṭipadaṃ.
mn12:36.4: yathā paṭipanno ca kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā tiracchānayoniṃ upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi.
mn12:36.5: pettivisayañcāhaṃ sāriputta pajānāmi pettivisayagāmiñca maggaṃ pettivisayagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ.
mn12:36.6: yathā paṭipanno ca kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā pettivisayaṃ upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi.
mn12:36.7: manussecāhaṃ sāriputta pajānāmi, manussalokagāmiñca maggaṃ, manussalokagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ.
mn12:36.8: yathā paṭipanno ca kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā manussesu upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi.

mn12:36.10: yathā paṭipanno ca kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi–
mn12:36.11: nibbānañcāhaṃ sāriputta pajānāmi nibbānagāmiñca maggaṃ nibbānagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ.
mn12:36.12: yathā paṭipanno ca āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati, tañca pajānāmi.

mn12:37.7: tathāyaṃ bhavaṃ puriso paṭipanno tathā ca irīyati tañca maggaṃ samārūḷho yathā imaṃ yeva aṅgārakāsuṃ āgamissatīti.

mn12:44.1: abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ sāriputta caturaṅgasamannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritā:
mn12:44.2: tapassissudaṃ homi paramatapassī. lūkhassudaṃ homi paramalūkho. jegucchī sudaṃ homi paramajegucchī. pavivittassudaṃ homi paramapavivitto.
mn12:45.1: tatrassu me idaṃ sāriputta tapassitāya hoti: acelako homi muttācāro hatthāpalekhano, na ehibhaddantiko na tiṭṭhabhaddantiko. na abhihaṭaṃ na uddissa kaṭaṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyāmi.
mn12:45.2: so na kumbhimukhā patigaṇhāmi, na kaḷopimukhā patigaṇhāmi, na eḷakamantaraṃ na daṇḍamantaraṃ na musalamantaraṃ, na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, na gabbhiniyā, na pāyamānāya, na purisantaragatāya, na saṅkittīsu, na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti, na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ na maṃsaṃ, na suraṃ na merayaṃ na thusodakaṃ pivāmi.
mn12:45.3: so ekāgāriko vā homi ekālopiko, dvāgāriko vā homi dvālopiko, sattāgāriko vā homi sattālopiko.
mn12:45.4: ekissāpi dattiyā yāpemi. dvīhipi dattīhi yāpemi. sattahipi dattīhi yāpemi.
mn12:45.5: ekāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāremi. dvīhikampi āhāraṃ āhāremi. sattāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāremi. iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikampi pariyāyabhattabhojanānuyogamanuyutto viharāmi.
mn12:45.6: so sākabhakkho vā homi, sāmākabhakkho vā homi, nīvārabhakkho vā homi, daddulabhakkho vā homi, haṭabhakkho vā homi, kaṇabhakkho vā homi, ācāmabhakkho vā homi, piññākabhakkho vā homi, tiṇabhakkho vā homi, gomayabhakkho vā homi. vanamūlaphalāhāro vā yāpemi pavattaphalabhojī.
mn12:45.7: so sāṇānipi dhāremi, masāṇānipi dhāremi, tirīṭānipi dhāremi, ajinampi dhāremi, ajinakkhipampi dhāremi, kusacīrampi dhāremi, vākacīrampi dhāremi, phalakacīrampi dhāremi, kesakambalampi dhāremi, vāḷakambalampi dhāremi, ulūkapakkhampi dhāremi. so
mn12:45.13: iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpanaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto viharāmi.
mn12:45.14: idaṃ su me sāriputta tapassitāya hoti.

mn12:49.2: yāvakīvañca me sāriputta sakaṃ muttakarīsaṃ apariyādinnaṃ hoti, sakaṃ yeva sudaṃ muttakarīsaṃ āhāremi.

mn12:50.2: tatra sudaṃ sāriputta bhiṃsanakassa vanasaṇḍassa bhiṃsanakatasmiṃ hoti:

mn12:50.4: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta yā tā rattiyo sītā hemantikā antaraṭṭhake himapātasamaye, tathārūpāsu rattīsu rattiṃ abbhokāse viharāmi divā vanasaṇḍe.
mn12:50.5: gimhānaṃ pacchime māse divā abbhokāse viharāmi rattiṃ vanasaṇḍe.
mn12:50.6: apissu maṃ sāriputta ayaṃ anacchariyā gāthā paṭibhāsi pubbe assutapubbā:
mn12:51.1: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta, susāne seyyaṃ kappemi chavaṭṭhikāni upadhāya.
mn12:51.2: apissu maṃ sāriputta gomaṇḍalā upasaṅkamitvā oṭṭhubhantipi, omuttentipi, paṃsukenapi okiranti. kaṇṇasotesu’pi salākaṃ pavesenti.
mn12:51.3: na kho panāhaṃ sāriputta abhijānāmi tesu pāpakaṃ cittaṃ uppādetā.
mn12:51.4: idaṃ su me sāriputta upekkhāvihārasmiṃ hoti.

mn12:52.5: te kolampi khādanti, kolacuṇṇampi khādanti, kolodakampi pivanti,
mn12:52.7: abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ sāriputta ekaṃyeva kolaṃ āhāraṃ āhāritā.
mn12:52.8: siyā kho pana te sāriputta evamassa:
mn12:52.9: mahā nūna tena samayena kolo ahosīti.
mn12:52.10: na kho panetaṃ sāriputta evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn12:52.11: tadāpi eta paramoyeva kolo ahosi, seyyathāpi etarahi.
mn12:52.12: tassa mayhaṃ sāriputta ekaṃyeva kolaṃ āhāraṃ āhārayato adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti:
mn12:52.13: seyyathāpi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā, evamevassu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.14: seyyathāpi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ, evamevassu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.15: seyyathāpi nāma vaṭṭanāvaḷī, evamevassu me piṭṭhikaṇṭako uṇṇatāvanato hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.16: seyyathāpi nāma jarasālāya gopānasiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti, evamevassu me phāsuḷiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.17: seyyathāpi nāma gambhīre udapāne udakatārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti, evamevassu me akkhikūpesu akkhitārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.18: seyyathāpi nāma tittakālābu āmakacchinno vātātapena samphuṭito hoti sammilāto, evamevassu me sīsacchavi samphuṭitā hoti sammilātā, tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.19: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta udaracchaviṃ parimasissāmīti piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ yeva parigaṇhāmi. piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ parimasissāmīti udaracchaviṃyeva parigaṇhāmi. yāvassu me sāriputta udaracchavi piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ allīnā hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.20: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta, vaccaṃ vā muttaṃ vā karissāmīti tattheva avakujjo papatāmi. tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.21: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta tameva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anomajjāmi. tassa mayhaṃ sāriputta pāṇinā gattāni anomajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā papatanti. tāyevappāhāratāya.

mn12:57.3: na kho penaso sāriputta saṃsāro sulabharūpo yo mayā asaṃsaritapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, aññatra suddhāvāsehi devehi.

mn12:60.3: na kho paneso sāriputta yañño sulabharūpo yo mayā ayiṭṭhapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, tañca kho raññā va satā khattiyena muddhāvasittena, brāhmaṇena vā mahāsālena.
mn12:61.1: santi kho pana sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:

mn12:62.1: santi kho pana sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn12:62.2: yāvadevāyaṃ bhavaṃ puriso daharo hoti yuvā susukāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā, tāvadeva paramena paññāveyyattiyena samannāgato hoti.
mn12:62.3: yato ca kho ayaṃ bhavaṃ puriso jiṇṇo hoti vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto: āsītiko vā nāvutiko vā vassasatiko vā jātiyā, atha tamhā paññāveyyattiyā parihāyatī ti.
mn12:62.4: na kho panetaṃ sāriputta evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn12:62.5: ahaṃ kho pana sāriputta etarahi jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto, āsītiko me vayo vattati.
mn12:62.6: idha me assu sāriputta cattāro sāvakā vassasatāyukā vassasatajīvino paramāya gatiyā satiyā ca dhitiyā ca samannāgatā paramena ca paññāveyyattiyena.
mn12:62.7: seyyathāpi sāriputta daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho katūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasireneva tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya,
mn12:62.8: evaṃ adhimattasatimanto evaṃ adhimattagatimanto evaṃ adhimattadhitimanto evaṃ paramena paññāveyyattiyena samannāgatā.
mn12:62.9: te maṃ catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ upādāyupādāya pañhaṃ puccheyyuṃ, puṭṭho puṭṭho cāhaṃ tesaṃ vyākareyyaṃ. vyākatañca me vyākatato dhāreyyuṃ. na ca maṃ dutiyakaṃ uttariṃ paṭipuccheyyuṃ.
mn12:62.10: aññatra asitapītakhāyitasāyitā, aññatra uccārapassāvakammā, aññatra niddākiḷamathapaṭivinodanā, apariyādiṇṇā yevassa sāriputta tathāgatassa dhammadesanā. apariyādiṇṇaṃ yevassa tathāgatassa dhammapada byañjanaṃ. apariyādiṇṇaṃ yevassa tathāgatassa pañhapaṭibhānaṃ.
mn12:62.11: atha me te cattāro sāvakā vassasatāyukā vassasatajīvino vassasatassa accayena kālaṃ kareyyuṃ.
mn12:62.12: mañcakena cepi maṃ sāriputta pariharissatha nevatthi tathāgatassa paññāveyyattiyassa aññathattaṃ.
